messages:
alex: noticed sustained admission throttles on reserved-pool-12 in us-west-1 since 02:32 PDT (~09:32 UTC). p95 queue climbing fast.
mona: console shows pool_admit dropped from 1500 -> 260 rps, queue ~24.7k, pool_util 99.4% :warning:
ops-bot: alert: dedicated_pool_throttle | pool=reserved-pool-12 region=us-west-1 trigger=admit_drop ts=1773456789
ryan: any recent autoscaler or network changes? I see a deploy at 02:20 that changed nodeGroup minSize.
teja: infra-ci changed nodeGroup autoscaler bounds to allow aggressive scale-down at 02:18 to save cost — might have too small buffer.
alex: also seeing node egress errors in klog: a couple G4 nodes losing ephemeral network routes causing scheduler evictions; k8s events show pods pending.
ryan: snapshot:
```
queue_length: 24700
admit_rate: 262 req/s
pool_util: 99.4%
nodes_ready: 18/22
network_err_rate: 5.8%
```
mona: looks like combined failure: aggressive scale-down reduced spare nodes, then a small network flake caused pod restarts and churn -> admission pressure.
ops-bot: runbook: dedicated-pool-throttle -> step escalate to infra at 1773456810
teja: rolling back autoscaler minSize to previous value to restore spare capacity: nodeGroup=min-g4 -> min=26
```
# rollback command
kubectl -n infra patch cm autoscaler-config --patch '{"spec":{"minSize":26}}'
```
ryan: also enabling per-tenant soft cap for top noisy tenant (tenant-ML) tenant-ML=300 req/s
alex: enabled overflow routing for best-effort to model-variant-cheap at 1773456835
teja: after those actions admitted climbed to ~980 rps, queue dropped to 9.6k, p99 latency improving.
ryan: follow-ups: add autoscaler safety check preventing minSize < predicted buffer for 3h rolling average; add network route health checks that avoid node eviction during transient egress errors.
mona: assign postmortem to teja + ryan. deliverables: timeline, root cause (cost-driven autoscaler change + transient network flake + no safety buffers), remediation (autoscaler guard, network pre-drain avoidance, per-tenant caps), and a small cost-impact analysis for keeping buffer.
alex: thanks all — marking mitigated. keeping thread open for postmortem drafts. :thumbsup:
